text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx + timeout spike detected for /v1/generate across us-west-2 gateway. Error rate jumped from ~0.1% to 8% at 12:12:03 UTC. Paging on-call. Correlation sample: corr=6f1a2b3c, corr=9d8f7e6a.

alice (oncall): acked. I'm on it. Can someone confirm customer impact and top routes?

sanjay: seeing it across several routes but highest on /v1/generate and /v1/embed. Grafana: latency p50 ~120ms -> p50 ~450ms, p95 1.8s -> 6.2s. 5xx most commonly 504/502 from gateway. Link: https://grafana.redwood/alerts/18325

leo: adding logs. From gateway logs (filtered):
```
[2026-03-10T12:12:14Z] req_id=6f1a2b3c route=/v1/generate upstream=10.0.3.12:443 status=504 backend_latency=4.5s retries=2
[2026-03-10T12:12:15Z] req_id=9d8f7e6a route=/v1/generate upstream=10.0.3.14:443 status=502 backend_latency=1.1s retries=3
```

maria: hypothesis: client-side retries + gateway retries overlapping causing retry amplification. Also noticing a surge of short-lived connections: looks like thousands of simultaneous connections from a small set of IPs. Could be a retry loop from client SDK or a change on a major customer.

kate (cs): we're getting pings from one enterprise customer (ACME Corp) reporting slow responses and timeouts starting ~12:10 UTC. They've been on a private Dedicated pool but appear to be hitting hosted gateway due to routing fallback. /cc @alice

alice (oncall): OK — two workstreams: 1) quick mitigation to reduce customer impact, 2) gather timeline and evidence for RCA. I'm going to disable gateway automatic retries for the affected routes (temporarily) and set retry-policy=0. Maria, can you validate before I flip?

maria: on it. Running the change in staging first. Patch: `PATCH /config/routes/retry?route=/v1/generate` payload `{"retries":0}`

devops-bot: deploy started: config-change-retries-disable-18325 by alice. Canary to 10% of gateway nodes.

sanjay: while that's rolling, I'm tailing model-serving logs. I see increased queue times in the model-serving pool:
```
[2026-03-10T12:11:58Z] model-pool-12 queue_wait=4200ms pods=3 ready_replicas=1
[2026-03-10T12:12:05Z] model-pool-14 queue_wait=3800ms pods=3 ready_replicas=1
```
Looks like pods didn't scale up. Autoscaler config changed yesterday (thresholds bumped). Could be related.

leo: correlation id `6f1a2b3c` traces to gateway->proxy->model-frontend->model-backend. Proxy logs show 504 due to backend read timeout of 4.5s. Upstream latency spike started at 12:10:45 UTC.

maria: confirmed rollback candidate: revert autoscaler threshold for model-service from 90%->70%. Current autoscaler uses CPU util only; we should consider p95 latency-based scaling.

alice (oncall): mitigation update: retries disabled on /v1/generate and /v1/embed rolled to 100% at 12:16:22 UTC. Observed immediate drop in 5xx rate to ~1.1% and p95 latency dropped to 2.1s. Customer reports partial recovery. :thumbsup:

kate (cs): ACME confirmed partial recovery at 12:18 UTC. They still saw a few timeouts but overall throughput restored. Notifying them of investigation.

devops-bot: exec: scaling action suggested: `kubectl scale --replicas=6 deploy/model-frontend --namespace=prod` (manual override)

leo: I applied a manual scale to 6 replicas at 12:19:05 UTC. model pool ready_replicas=6 -> queue_wait dropped under 400ms. No immediate errors after that.

sanjay: collecting full correlation traces for root cause thread: corr=6f1a2b3c, corr=9d8f7e6a, corr=b2c3d4e5. Pushing logs to /tmp/incident-18325-logs.tar.gz and to S3: s3://redwood-incident-logs/18325/

maria: short timeline for RCA draft:
- 12:10:40 UTC: p95 latency of model-service begins to climb (cold-start-like behavior)
- 12:10:45 UTC: gateway proxies observe first backend read timeouts -> gateway begins automatic retries
- 12:11:00 UTC: client SDKs observe timeouts and fire client retries (some large customers with aggressive retry configs)
- 12:12:00 UTC: retry amplification peaks, model-service queue fills, autoscaler doesn't react due to higher threshold config change from yesterday
- 12:16:22 UTC: retries disabled at gateway -> immediate reduction in amplification
- 12:19:05 UTC: manual scale increases replicas -> backend latency normalized

alice (oncall): evidence supports dual cause: (A) mis-tuned autoscaler that delayed scaling during a sudden traffic spike; (B) retry amplification across gateway + client SDKs that multiplied request pressure. Both necessary for severity.

leo: additional note: gateway retry backoff was linear and capped low, allowing multiple rapid retries. Suggest changing gateway retry policy to exponential backoff with jitter and limit total retries to 1 for user-facing routes.

maria: agreed. Also need better telemetry: propagate a unified correlation header `X-Redwood-Corr` and ensure it surfaces in autoscaler metrics and dashboards so we can quickly tie expensive traces to customers.

kate (cs): I'll draft customer-facing summary and send to ACME and a small banner to status.redwood.com.

alice (oncall): immediate action items (assigned):
- Revert autoscaler threshold change (sanjay) — STATUS: in progress
- Update gateway retry defaults to 1 + exponential backoff (leo) — STATUS: triage
- Add correlation header propagation to model-service logs (maria) — STATUS: queued
- Post incident note on status.redwood.com + customer DM (kate) — STATUS: in progress

devops-bot: change applied: autoscaler threshold revert scheduled by sanjay.

sanjay: reverted autoscaler to previous config at 12:31:10 UTC. will monitor.

alice (oncall): handing off to night oncall @leo at 12:40 UTC. I'll prepare the incident channel summary and link artifacts.

leo: taking over. I'll continue monitoring and start the RCA doc. Can we assign postmortem owners? Suggest sanjay + maria + leo for technical, kate for customer comms.

maria: I'll start a seed RCA in google docs and add log pointers and timeline. Key hypothesis to test: autoscaler delay alone would not have caused outage; it magnified client retry behavior. We'll validate by replaying traffic against staging with current autoscaler config.

alice (oncall): thanks team. Final notes: correlation ids collected: [6f1a2b3c, 9d8f7e6a, b2c3d4e5]. Artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-incident-logs/18325/, /tmp/incident-18325-logs.tar.gz. Runbook update: add step to disable gateway retries as a fast mitigation for retry amplification events.

kate (cs): CS has notified ACME and offered a post-incident call.

leo: I'm leaving the channel open for questions. Will post RCA draft link here when ready. :white_check_mark:
